title: Hearty Scottish Lentil Pie
description: A traditional Scottish-inspired pie made with lentils and topped with a crumbly cottage cheese crust.
instructions: In a large saucepan, sauté the onions and carrots in butter until tender.
Add the lentils, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 5 minutes.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until the lentils are tender.
While the lentils are cooking, prepare the crust by mixing the cottage cheese and flour in a bowl.
Transfer the lentil mixture to a 9-inch pie dish and top with the cottage cheese crust.
Bake the pie in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes or until the crust is golden brown.
Let the pie cool for 10 minutes before serving.
